The improvement of tensile properties at room temperature and high temperatures after heat treatment was mainly attributed to the dispersion strengthening of the fine dispersed θ′-Al2Cu nanophase. The Orowan strengthening mechanism could explain this.
The residual θ-Al2Cu in this experiment would also grow into coarse particles through the Oswald ripening mechanism during the solution–aging process.
